artifacts.description: feat(core): end-of-part marker in the document history (M3-09a)

acceptance_criteria: `Document::end_of_part(&self) -> usize`: the number of features above the marker (`0..=history().len()`). A new document has 0. While the marker is at the end, `add_feature` keeps it at the end.
`Document::active_features(&self) -> &[Feature]`: `history()[..end_of_part()]`. `history()` still returns every feature, rolled back or not.

`Document::set_end_of_part(&mut self, pos: usize) -> Result<Vec<FeatureId>, ModelError>`: moves the marker and returns the features that became active (they must be rebuilt), in history order. Moving it up or keeping it in place returns an empty list. `pos > history().len()` is a new `ModelError::MarkerOutOfRange { pos, len }` with a `Display` message, and the marker doesn't move.

`add_feature` inserts at the marker (index `end_of_part()`) and moves the marker down by one. Every input must be an active feature. An input that exists but is rolled back is `ModelError::ForwardReference`, and the history and the marker don't change. New features still get fresh, increasing `FeatureId`s, so history order can differ from id order.
`dirty_after_param_change` and `dirty_after_feature_edit` return only active features. Editing a rolled-back feature returns `Ok(vec[])`. An unknown id is still `UnknownFeature`.
Unit tests, with S0 = Sketch, E1 = Extrude { profile: S0, depth: "d" } and S2 = Sketch, added in that order: (seven listed cases)
No new dependencies, no `unsafe`, and `swx-core` still depends on no workspace crate.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
